RDPLauncher 1.1 can join its taskbar widget with AudioFlipper's, so the two work as one.

## New

- **Link with AudioFlipper**: with AudioFlipper 1.3 or later running, right-click either widget,
  choose **Link with AudioFlipper** and which side AudioFlipper goes on. Linked, the two widgets
  sit side by side with a divider between them, and dragging either moves both. If one hides (a
  section turned off, or the app exits), the other takes its place. **Not linked** separates them
  again, each staying where it is.

## Updating

Exit the running copy (right-click the widget → **Exit**), replace RDPLauncher.exe with the new one
and start it. Your computers and display buttons are kept. Update AudioFlipper to 1.3 too to link
the two.
